Win Either Half Meaning (HWEH or AWEH)

"Win Either Half" (often shortened to HWEH for Home Win Either Half, or AWEH for Away Win Either Half) is a type of betting option where you predict that a team will win at least one of the two halves of the match.

HWEH (Home Win Either Half) Explained

HWEH means that you are betting on the home team to win either the first half or the second half of the match, regardless of the overall match result. This means if the home team wins just one of the halves, your bet is successful.

Let’s say Manchester United is playing against Arsenal at home, and you place a Home Win Either Half (HWEH) bet on Manchester United.

If Manchester United wins the first half (even if they lose the second half or the match overall), you win your bet.

Also, if Manchester United wins the second half (even if they lose the first half or the match overall), you win your bet.

So, with a HWEH bet, you only need Manchester United to win one of the two halves.

AWEH (Away Win Either Half) Explained

means you are betting on the away team to win at least one of the two halves of the match. If the away team wins either the first half or the second half, your bet is a winner.

Let’s take, for instance, if Chelsea wins the first half (even if they lose the second half of the match overall), you win your bet.

And if Chelsea wins the second half (even if they lose the first half or the match overall), you win your bet.

The away team needs to win one of the halves, and if they do, your bet wins.

 

Win Either Half Correct Score

Win Either Half Correct Score is a type of bet where you predict not only which team will win one of the halves but also what the score will be in that half. 

It’s a bit more challenging than other bets, but it can give you a bigger payout if you get it right.

For example, let’s say there’s a match between Chelsea and Asernal. You could bet that Chelsea will win the first half and that the score will be 1-0. If Team Chelsea wins the first half and the score is exactly 1-0, you win your bet.

What Does Away Team To Win Either Half Mean?

When you bet on the Away Team to Win Either Half, you're predicting that the away team will win at least one of the two halves of the match. You don't need the away team to win the full game, just one half.

For example, if Chelsea is playing against Tottenham at Tottenham’s stadium, and you place a bet on Chelsea to win either half, you are betting that Chelsea will win either the first half or the second half of the match. 

If Chelsea wins the first half or the second half, your bet is successful. However, if they lose both halves, you lose your bet.

What Is The Meaning Of Away Team Win To Nil No?

"Away Team Win to Nil No" means you're betting that the away team will win the match, but the match will not end with a Nil score, meaning the home team will score at least one goal. If the away team wins the match but the home team scores, the bet is lost.

For example, if Arsenal plays against Newcastle, and you place a bet on "Away Team Win to Nil No", you are betting that Newcastle will win but Arsenal will score at least one goal.

What Does "Away Team To Win Either Half No" Mean?

"Away Team to Win Either Half No" means you are betting that the away team will not win either half of the match. If the away team fails to win both halves, the bet is successful. If the away team wins any half, you lose your bet.

For example, if Real Madrid is playing against Sevilla, and you bet on Away Team to Win Either Half No, you are betting that Sevilla will not win the first half or the second half of the match. If Real Madrid wins both halves, your bet is a loss.

What Are The Odds For Win Either Half Bets?
